control_semantics.comparability: CONTROL = all eligible finalized observations of this same cohort (PASS + REJECT + MISSING_FEATURE). It is NOT an independently collected cohort and NOT a counterfactual control; it contains both compared groups by construction. No paired delta PASS-vs-CONTROL is claimed.
control_semantics.frozen_definition: Registry hypothesis: 'Prospectively compare exhaustion_magnitude <= 0.4 against > 0.4, with all eligible signals as CONTROL.'

dependence.note: Overlapping 240-minute hold windows inside the same symbol mean individual observations are not independent bets; dependence is handled through day- and symbol-block resampling, which are reported separately and are not a calibrated joint CI.

frozen_protocol.eligibility_rule: signal_time > freeze_ts (strict; exact freeze timestamp is ineligible)
frozen_protocol.entry_rule: NEXT_OPEN_5M: opening price of the first strictly later 5m execution candle
frozen_protocol.intrabar_policy: STOP_FIRST (conservative; ambiguous intrabar never assumed favourable)

limitations: No operator-approved statistical decision gates or inference method exist for this experiment; all intervals are exploratory (STATISTICAL_METHOD_NOT_APPROVED).
Day-block and symbol-block bootstrap intervals are separate single-axis sensitivity intervals, NOT a calibrated joint multiway 95% CI.
PASS and REJECT are disjoint unpaired groups; no paired delta is identifiable and REJECT n=29 is imprecise.
9 OOS UTC days only; day-level generalization is weak and no minimum_oos_days was pre-registered.
Shadow NEXT_OPEN_5M fills are hypothetical execution models, not executable proof (frozen entry_rule).
Completeness of observer capture (missed eligible candidates) cannot be proven from stored rows alone; source_signal_id is a deterministic synthetic key and does not join back to dds.scanner_setup.
research.prospective_outcome contains no rows for this experiment; the authoritative outcome source is research.me_reverse_long_v3_execution_outcome (documented, not an error).

reproducibility.determinism: All resampling uses fixed seeds recorded in uncertainty.seeds; outputs are key-sorted and contain no runtime timestamps, so repeated runs are byte-identical.

robustness.note: REJECT n=29 with 12 SL_FIRST / 14 TP_FIRST / 3 TIMEOUT; mean is highly sensitive to single trades (see LEAVE_ONE_SYMBOL_OUT rows). Exploratory only.

uncertainty.interpretation: All intervals are EXPLORATORY. No pre-registered statistical decision gates and no operator-approved inference method exist for MOMENTUM_EXHAUSTION_REVERSE_LONG_V3_OOS (frozen registry entry contains only sample-size gates). Day-block and symbol-block intervals are reported per dependence axis and are NOT a calibrated joint multiway 95% CI. The two-way pigeonhole bootstrap is an uncalibrated sensitivity only.

pass_minus_reject_net_normal.note: PASS and REJECT are unpaired disjoint groups within one cohort; no paired delta is claimed. REJECT n=29 makes its mean imprecise; treat REJECT statistics as exploratory.

resampling_units.diff: independent two-sample resampling; groups share no paired rows

rationale: Frozen PASS hypothesis (exhaustion_magnitude <= 0.4 implies positive executable edge and outperforms > 0.4) is NOT confirmed: PASS Net E[R] normal = -0.2817 R over N=107 with every single-axis exploratory 95% interval entirely below zero.
Pre-registered readiness gates are met (minimum_n=100: PASS n=107; minimum_symbols=10: 37 PASS symbols), so this is not a sample-size-limited inconclusive result.
The negative result is robust to leave-one-day-out, leave-one-symbol-out, top-3 symbol exclusions, elevated costs, and removal of TIMEOUT trades (PASS mean worsens to -0.6833 without TIMEOUT).

PASS underperforms the frozen aggregate CONTROL baseline (all eligible: -0.2050 R); REJECT (+0.0780 R, n=29, exploratory) is higher than PASS, i.e. the frozen threshold direction is contradicted on this cohort.
CLOSED_NEGATIVE_RECOMMENDED is NOT issued because no operator-approved negative decision gates or approved inference method were ever frozen for this experiment (blocker documented).

INCONCLUSIVE_CONTINUE_OOS is not warranted: data are sufficient to reject a positive PASS edge at the pre-registered readiness gates; further accumulation under the frozen protocol has negligible marginal value.
PIPELINE_OR_METHOD_FIX_REQUIRED is not warranted: the frozen pipeline passed every integrity check and reproduced all operator-audit values exactly.

Any further research requires a NEW separately frozen hypothesis (new cohort, new freeze, discovery/validation separation); the inverted PASS/REJECT ordering may not be re-used from this OOS sample for validation.
